messages:
kat: deploy-bot just aborted the canary rollout for 2026.3.1 — flagged missing param in prod :thinking_face:
deploy-bot: :warning: Rollout aborted at step=apply-config reason=missing_param key=/services/cache/namespace in target=prod
kat: ugh, that key exists in staging but not prod? can someone confirm namespace is set in prod paramstore?
sanjay: pulling prod params now, one sec
elena: @sanjay FYI we rotated KMS last week for prod — could be an encryption/kms arn mismatch when reading paramstore
sanjay: confirmed: /services/cache/namespace is present in staging -> "redwood-cache-v2" but in prod the param is present as encrypted blob with a different key id. trying `aws ssm get-parameter --name /services/cache/namespace --with-decryption`
sanjay: output: "An error occurred (AccessDeniedException) when calling the GetParameter operation: User is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt with kms key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:alias/redwood-legacy-key"
morgan: so prod has param but encrypted with a legacy key that the inference service role can't use. that explains why the service falls back and then deploy-bot detects missing config
kat: feels like an env-parity gap after the KMS rotation. staging was updated to new key but prod still references legacy alias. who owns the param rotation?
elena: that was on the infra rotation board; looks like the param path was updated in staging during the rollout test but prod never got the migration job because we gated it behind the old env var check
morgan: options: 1) rollback the canary (we're still at 0% traffic) 2) patch role policy to allow decrypt with legacy key (fast) 3) update prod param to new key (risky during change window)
kat: change window opens in 3 hours. if we can patch role policy quickly and verify, we can resume the rollout before window. prefer not to change param itself right now.
sanjay: patch would be to add kms:Decrypt for alias/redwood-legacy-key to inference-service-prod role. can do a scoped change and test with a single canary pod.
ops-bot: NOTE: any IAM policy change must be approved by infra-sig per the playbook. Approval pending.
morgan: I'll ping infra-sig and request emergency approval, include minimal policy delta and a revert plan.
kat: also add a release-note blurb: "Hotfix: temporary decrypt permission to recover prod param access during KMS rotation"
elena: add an entry to the rollout notes and tag security for audit. we should schedule a follow-up to re-encrypt the param with the new key and remove the temporary permission within 24 hours.
sanjay: prep patch: `aws iam put-role-policy --role-name inference-service-prod --policy-document file://allow-decrypt-temporary.json` (will post diff once ready)
morgan: infra-sig approved 10:42 — minimal policy allowed for 1 hour testing.
kat: ok go ahead but only apply to canary node pool first. monitor logs and deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: :rocket: Applying canary to 1 pod for release=2026.3.1 target=canary
sanjay: patch applied to canary role, trying get-parameter again...
sanjay: success. param decrypted, service picks up namespace and initializes cache.
kat: nice. monitor latency and errors for 10m, then we can gradually increase traffic if stable.
morgan: observing no errors, p50/p95 token latencies steady. no cache init errors in logs.
kat: decision: resume rollout with staged traffic increments. we will NOT modify prod param or KMS aliases outside change window. schedule follow-up ticket to rotate param encryption and revoke temporary policy.
elena: I'll create a postmortem-style note and add to the release notes: short cause, mitigation, follow-up actions (ticket ids).
kat: thanks all. leaving the thread open until we confirm full rollout at +60 minutes. :thumbsup:
